**What you'll do**

1. Read what the Cry Baby wah is.
2. Learn how its circuit makes its sound.

4. Listen to famous tracks.
5. Check yourself with a short quiz.
:::

## What it is

- The wah pedal was made by **Brad Plunkett** at Warwick Electronics / Thomas Organ in **1966** and sold from February 1967; **Cry Baby** was the name for America (Wikipedia, "Wah-wah pedal").
- One control: the **treadle**. Rock it with your foot. Press the toe down hard to switch it on or off.

## How it makes its sound

- Inside, an inductor and a capacitor make a **resonance**: a narrow peak of frequencies made louder (a *band-pass*). The treadle turns a pot that moves the peak (Wikipedia; ElectroSmash, from a search summary).
- Heel down: the peak is low (about 400 Hz in this model), a dark "oo". Toe down: high (about 2.2 kHz), a bright "ee". Rocking between them says "wah".
- Parked half way, it is a fixed filter: a nasal sound some players use on purpose.
- This page cannot feel your foot, so it can rock the treadle for you, or move it with how loud you play.

## The pedal

The Cry Baby wah's face, drawn after photos (positions approximate, no logos). Drag a knob (or use the arrow keys), click the footswitch to bypass, then press a ▶ button. The guitar is this site's pickup model (pick one, and its volume, below the buttons); the sound goes through the pedal model, then a clean amp. Nobody has compared it with a real pedal. The picture shows the waveform going in and coming out.

## Guided tour

```{=html}
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="crybaby" data-set="{&quot;mode&quot;:&quot;rock&quot;,&quot;rate&quot;:3}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Rocking slowly.</b> The classic "wah".</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="crybaby" data-set="{&quot;mode&quot;:&quot;rock&quot;,&quot;rate&quot;:8}" data-play="chord"><p><b>Rocking fast on chords.</b> The funk "wacka".</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="crybaby" data-set="{&quot;mode&quot;:&quot;foot&quot;,&quot;pos&quot;:0}" data-play="lead"><p><b>Heel down.</b> Dark.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="crybaby" data-set="{&quot;mode&quot;:&quot;foot&quot;,&quot;pos&quot;:10}" data-play="lead"><p><b>Toe down.</b> Bright and piercing.</p></div>
<div class="pd-step" data-pedal="crybaby" data-set="{&quot;mode&quot;:&quot;env&quot;}" data-play="riff"><p><b>Moved by your playing.</b> Loud notes push the peak up (an auto-wah: the page's, not the pedal's).</p></div>
```
